title: Message to Whiterun (Imperial)
description: General Tullius sends the player to deliver a message to Jarl Balgruuf of Whiterun, offering Imperial military support against a potential Stormcloak attack. Balgruuf sends his war axe to Ulfric Stormcloak as a traditional Nord peace offering, but Ulfric rejects it, signaling war. The player must warn Balgruuf and report to Legate Quentin Cipius as the Battle for Whiterun begins.

base_facts: I am the military governor of Skyrim and commander of the Imperial Legion stationed in Solitude.
I am concerned about a potential Stormcloak attack on Whiterun and want the Legion to be part of its defense.

QUEST_BEGUN: I have sent the player to deliver my message to Jarl Balgruuf, offering Imperial military support in exchange for Whiterun's allegiance to the Empire.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have received Balgruuf's letter confirming Whiterun's allegiance to the Empire and the terms for Legionnaires in the hold.
My Imperial forces are now actively defending Whiterun against the Stormcloak invasion.

base_facts: I am the Jarl of Whiterun, trying to keep my hold neutral in the Civil War.
I will not commit to the Empire until the dragon threat at Whiterun is dealt with.

MESSAGE_DELIVERED: I have received General Tullius's message but am reluctant to pick a side.
I am sending my war axe to Ulfric Stormcloak as a traditional Nord peace offering.
JARL_WARNED: Ulfric has rejected my axe, meaning war is coming to Whiterun.
I have accepted Imperial military support to defend the city.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have taken back my rejected war axe and abandoned Whiterun's neutrality to side with the Empire.
I am organizing the city's defenses alongside the Imperial forces stationed in Whiterun.
War has come to my city because Ulfric rejected my traditional peace offering.

base_facts: I am the Jarl of Windhelm and leader of the Stormcloak rebellion.
I seek to liberate Skyrim from Imperial rule.

AXE_DELIVERED: I have rejected Balgruuf's war axe, signaling that I will attack Whiterun.
I told the courier that Balgruuf should prepare to entertain visitors.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have rejected Balgruuf's war axe and ordered my Stormcloak forces to invade Whiterun.
My army is already marching on Whiterun to take the city by force.

base_facts: I am the Imperial Legate stationed in Whiterun.

REPORTED_TO_LEGATE: The Stormcloaks are already on the move toward Whiterun.
The defense of Whiterun must begin immediately.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have confirmed the Stormcloaks are already on the move toward Whiterun.
I have directed the player to rush to the city gates to defend against the incoming attack.
I am now commanding the Imperial defense of Whiterun as the Battle for Whiterun begins.

beats.comment: Player receives the quest from General Tullius to deliver a message to Jarl Balgruuf.
Player has delivered Tullius's message to Balgruuf and is waiting for his response.
Player has delivered Balgruuf's axe to Ulfric, who rejects it and prepares to attack Whiterun.
Player returns to warn Balgruuf that Ulfric plans to attack Whiterun.
Player reports to Legate Quentin Cipius as the Stormcloaks approach Whiterun.
Quest finishes, leading into Battle for Whiterun.
